concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-industries-peak-season-status-and-help]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen peak-season guide to checking live service status, subscribing to system messages, keeping business contacts current, and supplying issue-specific identifiers through ticket or phone support; the snapshot is not live incident or payment-outcome proof.
warnings: Service status, incidents, support availability and response must be checked live; the captured guide is not a current incident report or SLA.
Use business-specific contact details because the source says they may be shared with partners or appear on billing statements.
